node.statement: By def-extended-delta-inclusion, an extended d_1-inclusion with d_1<=W.c0_cb*epsilon satisfies the homomorphism-error and two-sided norm inequalities with the larger nonnegative tolerance W.c0_cb*epsilon; thus v_1 is an extended W.c0_cb*epsilon-inclusion. Set w_+:=v_1. The unit estimate in node 1.6 is exactly ||w_+(I_{C^{m+1}})-I_A||<=W.c0_cb*epsilon, proving the conclusion of node 1.
